trello.name: Fix Android 14 photo upload crash
trello.desc:
Yeah, that's the photo upload crash on Android 14. Crash reports show a NullPointerException in the media picker callback when the user backgrounds the app mid-upload. It's our top crasher right now, about 4% of Android sessions. Repro is: start a photo upload, background the app before it finishes, come back. I can take it.
Priya: Please do, and I'd like it fixed and verified by Wednesday so QA has time before the release. Sam, can you confirm the fix on the Android 14 test devices once Marcus lands it?
Sam: Yep, I'll add it to the regression run.

trello.name: Offline mode for notes list
trello.desc:
The backend side is a sync API: the client sends its last-synced timestamp and gets a delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. I'll build that endpoint this sprint. Conflict resolution is last-write-wins for now; we agreed we're not doing merge UI in this pass.
Marcus: And I'll do the client side: local cache in Room, queue writes while offline, replay them when connectivity comes back. Acceptance criteria as I understand it: you can open the app in airplane mode, see your notes, edit them, and everything reconciles when you're back online with no data loss.

trello.name: Migrate CI pipelines to GitHub Actions
trello.desc:
I want to migrate our pipelines to GitHub Actions. I've already got a proof of concept for the build job. This sprint I'd finish the test and release pipelines, keep the nightly build schedule, and run both systems in parallel for a week before we turn Jenkins off.
Priya: Approved, but keep Jenkins alive until the parallel week is clean.

trello.name: Add per-user rate limiting to search endpoint
trello.desc: The search endpoint got hammered by a misbehaving script last week and degraded for everyone. I'm going to add per-user rate limiting: 100 requests per minute per user, return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header beyond that. It also needs a metrics counter so we can see who's hitting the limit.

trello.name: Update GDPR consent screen for EU launch
trello.desc:
Legal flagged that our consent screen doesn't meet GDPR requirements for the EU launch. Marcus, we need the privacy policy screen updated so consent is opt-in with separate toggles for analytics and marketing, not a single pre-checked box. That has to be in the August 20 release, it's a launch blocker.
Marcus: Understood. I'll get the new copy from legal and rebuild the screen. Opt-in toggles, nothing pre-checked.

trello.name: Write automated regression tests for payments flow
trello.desc:
The payments flow still has no automated coverage and it burned us in the last release.
Sam: I'll write regression tests for the payments flow: purchase, restore, cancellation, and the receipt validation path. Goal is to have them running in CI as part of the new GitHub Actions pipeline.
